standard-dialogue.npc: Be careful in here, there's lots of dangerous equipment.

steps.npc: Nothing at the moment... It's broken. It's meant to be a transmutation machine.
It has also spent time as a time travel machine, and a dramatic lightning generator, and a thing for generating monsters.
No, I'm just one of the tenants. It belongs to the count who lives in the basement.

options.text: What does the portal machine do?

steps.player: What does the portal machine do?

steps.npc: Ah, an interesting question! I believe it should create a rift in the very fabric of space! Opening a portal to some, hitherto undiscovered plane that exists parallel to our own.

attempting-to-enter-the-interdimensional.npc: Errr, just before you go through there...
That portal opens into a plane populated with some very shocking creatures. You should wear some kind of insulated armour before going there.

options.text: Where can I get insulated armour from?

steps.player: Where can I get insulated armour from?

steps.npc: Well there were some pretty tough people here last week. Said they were Slayer Masters. They were planning on making some protective boots. You should speak to one of them.

options.text: I don't want to run around after Slayer Masters, I'm going through.

steps.player: I don't want to run around after Slayer Masters, I'm going through.

steps.npc: Fair enough, just don't say I didn't warn you
